title: zeroSDR
summary: zeroSDR turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket SDR receiver.
description:
FEATURES
- Real-time spectrum and waterfall on the 320x170 display
- FM / NFM / AM / USB / LSB demodulation with squelch, audio AGC and
  FM de-emphasis (50/75 us)
- Adjustable tuning step, display zoom, FFT size and sample rate
- On-screen key reference and settings panel (press H)
- ADSB aircraft page: sortable list, detail view with a PFD, and a radar
  view with a fading sweep, range rings and a large callsign plate
- Runs as the normal user through the librtlsdr udev rule - no root,
  no background service

REQUIRED EXTRA HARDWARE
- An RTL-SDR USB dongle (tested with RTL-SDR Blog V4 / RTL2832U).
  The app has no built-in radio, so a dongle is mandatory.
- An antenna: any VHF/UHF antenna for the SDR page; a 1090 MHz antenna
  for the ADSB page.
- The dongle plugs into the Cardputer Zero USB-A port and is powered by
  the device.

NOTES
- ADSB decoding is done by the external "readsb" program, which must be
  installed separately (a build with the RTL-SDR backend). Without it the
  ADSB list stays empty; the SDR page still works.
- Audio plays through the built-in speaker or the 3.5 mm jack.
